paite: Huan Naamath mi Zophar in adawng a, hichi in achi:
heading: Zophar Thugen Nihveina
english: Then Zophar the Naamathite answered,

paite: "Huaiziak in ka ngaihtuahnate'n kei dawnna ahon pia a, ka sung a om ka kinohna thu ziak mahmah in.
english: “Therefore my thoughts answer me, even by reason of my haste that is in me.

paite: Kei hon zahlaksak salhna ka zata a, ka theihsiamna kha in ahon dawng hi.
english: I have heard the reproof which puts me to shame. The spirit of my understanding answers me.

paite: "Leitung a mihing a-om nungsiah, hun lui thu hiai na thei kei maw;
english: Don’t you know this from old time, since man was placed on earth,

paite: Giloute vualzohna atom a, Pathian limsakloute nopsakna mitphiat kal sung lel ahi chih?
english: that the triumphing of the wicked is short, the joy of the godless but for a moment?

paite: Ahoihkimna in vante suntou in, alu in meipite phatou mahleh;
english: Though his height mount up to the heavens, and his head reach to the clouds,

paite: Himahleh amah ek bang in tangtawn in amangthang ding a, 'Koi a om ahia?' Amah mute'n achi ding uh.
english: yet he will perish forever like his own dung. Those who have seen him will say, ‘Where is he?’

paite: Mang bang in alengmang dia, muh in a-om kei ding hi; ahi, zan mengmuh bang in hawlmang in a-om ding hi.
english: He will fly away as a dream, and will not be found. Yes, he will be chased away like a vision of the night.

paite: Amah mu mit in amah amuta kei ding hi; amun in leng amah amuta kei ding hi.
english: The eye which saw him will see him no more, neither will his place see him any more.

paite: Atate'n gentheite deihsakna azong ding ua, akhutte'n athil hoih ape nawn ding hi.
english: His children will seek the favor of the poor. His hands will give back his wealth.

paite: "Atuailai hatna in aguhte dim mahleh, leivui ah amah toh alum ding uhi.
english: His bones are full of his youth, but youth will lie down with him in the dust.

paite: Akam ah gitlouhna khum in alei nuai ah sel mahleh;
english: “Though wickedness is sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue,

paite: Sit in, paisak kei in, akam ah kem gige zou mahleh;
english: though he spare it, and will not let it go, but keep it still within his mouth,

paite: Agil a an akitok a, asung ah gulgu bang in akha hi.
english: yet his food in his bowels is turned. It is cobra venom within him.

paite: Hauhsaknate anawmvalh a, alokhe nawn ding hi. Pathian in agilpi a kipan in apaikhe ding hi.
english: He has swallowed down riches, and he will vomit them up again. God will cast them out of his belly.

paite: Sokval gu atawp dia, gulngan in amah athat ding.
english: He will suck cobra venom. The viper’s tongue will kill him.

paite: Luipite, khuaizu leh nawituidat lui luangte a-en kei ding hi.
english: He will not look at the rivers, the flowing streams of honey and butter.

paite: Sepgim gah ape nawn dia anawmvalhsuk kei ding a; amuhsa ah kipahna anei kei ding.
english: He will restore that for which he labored, and will not swallow it down. He will not rejoice according to the substance that he has gotten.

paite: Ama'n lah gentheite anuaisiah a, amangngilh hi; alam louhpi inn hiamgamtak in alata uhi.
english: For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor. He has violently taken away a house, and he will not build it up.

paite: Adeihgawlna in huntawk anei kei a akipahpih thil himhim akhol kei ding.
english: “Because he knew no quietness within him, he will not save anything of that in which he delights.

paite: Anekgaih louh bangmah om lai a-om kei hi; huaiziak in ahauhna in adaih sawt kei ding.
english: There was nothing left that he didn’t devour, therefore his prosperity will not endure.

paite: Ahauh san lai in haksa sakna anei dia, thulimloumi khut ahong tung ding hi.
english: In the fullness of his sufficiency, distress will overtake him. The hand of everyone who is in misery will come on him.

paite: Agilpi hihdim ding a akisak lai in, Pathian in atung ah athangpaihna kihtakhuaina akhe ding a, anek lai in atung ah azusak ding hi.
english: When he is about to fill his belly, God will cast the fierceness of his wrath on him. It will rain on him while he is eating.

paite: Sik galvan a kipan atai dia, dal thal in amah akap pailet ding.
english: He will flee from the iron weapon. The bronze arrow will strike him through.

paite: Adokkhia a, apumpi a kipan in ahong paikhia; ahi, asinkha a pan amukzumte velvel hong paikhia a launate atung ah ahong tung hi.
english: He draws it out, and it comes out of his body. Yes, the glittering point comes out of his liver. Terrors are on him.

paite: Agou ding in mialna tengteng kholkhawm in a-om; mei mut louh in amah anegai ding; apuanin a nutsiat a om anegai ding hi.
english: All darkness is laid up for his treasures. An unfanned fire will devour him. It will consume that which is left in his tent.

paite: Vante'n abohsiatna ataklang ding ua, lei amah dou ding in athou ding.
english: The heavens will reveal his iniquity. The earth will rise up against him.

paite: A-inn a punna apaimang dia, aheh ni in avante aluangmang ding hi.
english: The increase of his house will depart. They will rush away in the day of his wrath.

paite: "Hiai Pathian a pan a migilou tantuan ahi, agouluah dia Pathian in asehsak."
english: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, the heritage appointed to him by God.”
